name: Dirk Straub
source:
Dirk is one of the three commanders. He is an tough man, responsible for the training of the new soldiers.

Brief information:
Symbol: Bullet
Best quality: Straightforwardness
Worst quality: Integrity
Main fear: Weakness
The most important thing in life: Adaptation
Flower: Burian
Musical instrument: Kettledrum

"If a person doesn't fight for their life, then they are no more valuable than the soup that is served in our dining room".

[From in-game character profile]
